summaries.Romania: Romania's healthcare system faces scrutiny after a patient died from a misdiagnosed heart attack, while political shifts continue with PNL forming a modernization bloc and Moldova strengthens energy independence from Russia. The country navigates security concerns amid Russian hybrid threats and manages infrastructure challenges across multiple sectors.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare innovation accelerates with AI-driven clinical tools, drug price negotiations codified, and digital health platforms expanding, while legacy challenges persist around physician payments and traditional care models. Major health insurers report strong growth amid shifting reimbursement landscapes and technological transformation.
summaries.Tech: Apple races to make Siri competitive as an AI agent while managing privacy concerns around Full Disk Access, Nvidia faces investigation into CEO's relationship with a Chinese intelligence operative, and the broader AI ecosystem grapples with copyright lawsuits and infrastructure demands. The tech sector confronts security, ethical, and geopolitical pressures as AI capabilities advance.

items.title: macOS 27.3 could change how you grant AI agents Full Disk Access, here’s how
items.snippet:
